[ For rollup teams ]

Launch with Ethereum’s apps from day one.

With EEZ, you can focus on growing your chain. Your users call mainnet contracts directly from your chain, and you keep your own sequencer and governance.

Before you commit

Properties of the current deployment.
vs
What you get

Works today

  • Calls to Ethereum and back in one transaction
  • Permissionless registration and proxy minting
  • Anyone can rebuild your chain from L1 with the deriver
Plan for these

In progress

  • L2-to-L2 mesh: coming. Today a cross-rollup call works between rollups verified in the same L1 block
  • Validity proofs: in progress. Batches are attested today
  • Production bridge: coming. The bundled bridge is a test fixture
  • Delivery guarantee: coming. Today the composer decides what lands

Two questions before we scope

Do you run a sequencer, and are you pre-launch or live? Those decide whether this is a config change or a hard fork.
